title: Challenges
subtitle: Define the module's challenges: each one links a lesson (its page), a quiz and the actions the learner must complete. A challenge is only completed —and grants points and a badge— when all its required actions are done.
importDescription: Creates (or updates) the 5 challenges of the Bienvenido module with their 3-question quizzes and actions, linking them to the lessons of the course "VENDE EN 24H CON DROPI". Safe to repeat: it never duplicates challenges or quizzes.
importWithoutLesson: {n, plural, one {# challenge has no lesson: no video with a matching title was found.} other {# challenges have no lesson: no videos with matching titles were found.}}
importConnectionCut: The connection was cut before finishing, but the import keeps running on the server. Reload in a few seconds.
empty: No challenges yet. Import them from the block above or create a new one.
confirmDelete: Delete the challenge "{title}" and its actions? This cannot be undone.
errorLoad: We could not load the challenges.
actionsHint: Video and quiz are implicit when the challenge has a lesson and a quiz. The other catalogue actions go here.
actionsEmpty: This challenge has no extra actions (video + quiz only).
actionConfigHelp: Depends on the type. Validated on save: if something is missing you will see why.
